## Download

| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit) | `Wordsmith-Setup-<version>.exe` |
| macOS, Apple silicon (M1 and later) | `Wordsmith-<version>-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `Wordsmith-<version>-x64.dmg` |
| Chrome and Edge extension | `wordsmith-browser-extension.zip` |

Once it's installed, Wordsmith looks for new versions itself. It downloads them in the background and installs them when you restart it.

### Opening it the first time

- **Windows:** this build isn't signed with a publisher certificate yet, so Windows warns you once. When SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **macOS:** drag Wordsmith into Applications and open it. The first time you use Check Anywhere, macOS asks you to allow Wordsmith under **Privacy & Security > Accessibility**, because it copies and pastes in other apps for you.
